definitions.gloss: wiping off; wiping away; removal by wiping
definitions.explanation: The act of cleaning or removing something by wiping with a cloth, tissue, or similar material.

examples.japanese: {汚|よご}れの{拭|ふ}き{取|と}りをする。
メイクの{拭|ふ}き{取|と}りには{専用|せんよう}のシートを{使|つか}う。
examples.english: I use special wipes to remove makeup.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}をこぼしたら、すぐに{拭|ふ}き{取|と}りをしてください。
examples.english: If you spill water, please wipe it up right away.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb {拭|ふ}き{取|と}る (to wipe off, to wipe away), which combines {拭|ふ}く (to wipe) and {取|と}る (to take, to remove). The emphasis is on the removal aspect — not just wiping, but wiping something away.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拭|ふ}き{取|と}りシート: wiping sheet, cleaning wipe
- {拭|ふ}き{取|と}り{用|よう}: for wiping/cleaning purposes
- {拭|ふ}き{取|と}り{掃除|そうじ}: cleaning by wiping
- {化粧|けしょう}{拭|ふ}き{取|と}り: makeup removal (by wiping)

RELATED WORDS:
- {拭|ふ}き{取|と}る: to wipe off (the verb form)
- {拭|ふ}き{掃除|そうじ}: wiping/mopping (general wiping as cleaning method)
- {水|みず}{拭|ぶ}き: damp wiping, wet wiping
- {乾|から}{拭|ぶ}き: dry wiping
